name: pet-studio-lite
description: Pet Studio Lite — 宠物包导入/检查/预览/配置/导出 Windows 便携桌宠

scripts.test: npm run test:petpack && npm run test:zip && npm run test:petdex && npm run test:runtime && npm run test:export-snapshot && npm run test:runtime-build && npm run test:windows-kit && npm run test:offline-export && npm run test:petdex-download && npm run test:image-probe
scripts.smoke:electron: npm run build:pet && esbuild scripts/smoke-round2.mts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node20 --outfile=scripts/smoke-round2.bundle.cjs --external:electron --packages=external && electron scripts/smoke-round2.bundle.cjs
scripts.smoke:multi: npm run build:pet && esbuild scripts/smoke-multi-runtime.mts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node20 --outfile=scripts/smoke-multi-runtime.bundle.cjs --external:electron --packages=external && electron scripts/smoke-multi-runtime.bundle.cjs
scripts.typecheck:windows-kit: tsc --noEmit --strict --target ES2022 --module ESNext --moduleResolution bundler --allowImportingTsExtensions --skipLibCheck --esModuleInterop scripts/windows-kit/validate.mts scripts/build-windows-kit.mts scripts/test-windows-kit.mts
scripts.prepare:studio: npm run build:pet && esbuild scripts/prepare-studio-runtime.mts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=scripts/prepare-studio-runtime.bundle.mjs && node scripts/prepare-studio-runtime.bundle.mjs
scripts.package:win: npm run build && npm run prepare:studio && esbuild scripts/package-studio.mts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=scripts/package-studio.bundle.mjs && node scripts/package-studio.bundle.mjs win
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && npm run prepare:studio && esbuild scripts/package-studio.mts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=scripts/package-studio.bundle.mjs && node scripts/package-studio.bundle.mjs mac
scripts.package:win:zip: npm run build && npm run prepare:studio && esbuild scripts/package-studio.mts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=scripts/package-studio.bundle.mjs && node scripts/package-studio.bundle.mjs win-zip

author: Pet Studio
